Configuring the cache

The toolkit stores downloaded model weights in a shared cache directory so that repeated runs do not fetch the same files twice. This page explains where the cache lives, how to move it, and how to clean it up safely.

Default location

On macOS and Linux the cache defaults to ~/.cache/toolkit. The directory is created on first use with permissions restricted to the current user.

Moving the cache

Set the TOOLKIT_CACHE environment variable before running any command:

export TOOLKIT_CACHE=/Volumes/fast-ssd/toolkit-cache
toolkit fetch speech-small --precision 4bit

Existing files are not migrated automatically. Copy the old directory to the new location first if you want to keep previously downloaded weights.

Cleaning up

  1. List cached entries with toolkit cache list.
  2. Remove a single model with toolkit cache rm NAME.
  3. Remove everything older than thirty days with toolkit cache prune --days 30.
CommandEffect
cache listShows name, size and last use
cache rmDeletes one entry
cache pruneDeletes stale entries

Note: pruning never touches a model that is currently loaded by a running process.
